tips: 短句化：长句拆成 2–3 个短句，每句保证主谓完整，阅卷优先看语法正确
专有名词要准确：背固定译法（春节 the Spring Festival、长城 the Great Wall），实在不会就写拼音并简短解释
不要逐字直译：先想“这句话英语习惯怎么说”，再落笔，而不是把汉字一一对应
遇到不会的词就降级换简单表达：比如“蜿蜒流过”不会写，就说 flows through——通顺比高级更重要
写完全篇留 2 分钟检查：时态、第三人称单数、单复数、冠词 a/the

passages.title: 春节
passages.zh: 春节是中国最重要的传统节日，标志着农历新年的开始。除夕之夜，全家人团聚在一起吃年夜饭，席间往往有鱼，因为“鱼”与“余”同音，寓意年年有余。长辈还会给晚辈发红包，祝愿他们新的一年平安顺遂。如今，越来越多的中国人选择通过旅行或看春晚来庆祝春节，但阖家团圆始终是节日不变的主题。
passages.en: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional holiday in China, marking the beginning of the lunar new year. On New Year's Eve, the whole family gets together for a reunion dinner. Fish is often served, because the Chinese word for "fish" sounds like "yu", meaning surplus, which symbolizes abundance year after year. Elders also give red envelopes to the younger generation, wishing them peace and good fortune in the coming year. Nowadays, more and more Chinese people celebrate the festival by traveling or watching the Spring Festival Gala, but family reunion remains the constant theme of the holiday.

terms.note: 固定译法，首字母大写
农历新年 the lunar new year
也可说 Chinese New Year's Eve dinner
给红包 give red envelopes
中央电视台主办，常加 CCTV

tips: “鱼与余同音”不要硬译双关：用 sounds like + meaning 把谐音的意思解释出来即可
长句“长辈还会给晚辈发红包，祝愿……”拆成主句 + 现在分词短语 wishing...

passages.title: 中国茶文化
passages.zh: 茶起源于中国，已有数千年历史。中国人不仅把茶当作日常饮品，还形成了独特的茶文化。泡茶讲究水温、茶叶和茶具的搭配，不同地区的人喜欢的茶也各不相同：北方人多饮花茶，南方人偏爱绿茶，而福建、广东一带则流行乌龙茶。对许多中国人来说，品茶不仅是解渴，更是一种放松身心、招待客人的方式。
passages.en: Tea originated in China and has a history of several thousand years. Chinese people do not just drink tea daily; they have also developed a unique tea culture. Brewing tea requires the right combination of water temperature, tea leaves and teaware. Preferences vary from region to region: people in the north favor scented tea, those in the south prefer green tea, while oolong tea is popular in Fujian and Guangdong. For many Chinese people, sipping tea is not just about quenching thirst—it is a way to relax and to entertain guests.

terms.note: 句首用过去式 originated
不可数；也可用 tea sets

terms.zh: 花茶 / 绿茶 / 乌龙茶
terms.note: 三种茶的固定说法
动宾搭配，常考

tips: 冒号后列举三个地区对比，用 while 引出最后一个最整齐
“放松身心、招待客人的方式”合并成一个 way to relax and to entertain guests，不必逐字译“身心”

passages.title: 中国书法
passages.zh: 中国书法是汉字书写的艺术，已有三千多年历史，被誉为「无言的诗，无形的舞」。书法分为篆书、隶书、楷书、行书、草书五种字体，其中楷书端正，行书流畅，最受初学者欢迎。东晋的王羲之被称为「书圣」，其代表作《兰亭序》被尊为「天下第一行书」。如今，书法也是学校传统文化教育的重要内容。每逢春节，许多家庭仍习惯手写春联，寄托美好祝愿。
passages.en: Chinese calligraphy is the art of writing Chinese characters. It has a history of more than three thousand years and is praised as a wordless poem and a formless dance. Through the shade of ink, the width of lines, and the balance of structure, it expresses the writer's feelings and personal cultivation. There are five main styles of calligraphy: seal script, official script, regular script, running script, and cursive script. Among them, regular script is neat and standard, while running script is smooth and natural, so they are the most popular choices for beginners. In history, Wang Xizhi of the Eastern Jin Dynasty was honored as the Sage of Calligraphy, and his famous work Lanting Xu is regarded as the best running script in the world. Today, calligraphy is not only an art form but also an important part of traditional culture education in schools. Every Spring Festival, many families still write spring couplets by hand to express their best wishes for the new year, bringing this ancient art into ordinary homes.

terms.note: 通用译法，首字母大写视语境
人名用拼音
朝代：the + 拼音 + Dynasty
称号意译，可加 the
作品名用拼音，斜体更规范

tips: 「无言的诗，无形的舞」不要逐字硬译，可处理为 a wordless poem and a formless dance，用 and 连接两个并列比喻。
五种字体的排比句先用 There are... 总起，再列举五个拼音词组，避免五个长定语堆在一个句子里。

passages.title: 剪纸
passages.zh: 剪纸是中国民间最普及的传统装饰艺术之一，已有一千五百年历史。它只用一把剪刀和一张纸，就能剪出花鸟鱼虫、人物故事等图案，可谓「方寸之间，气象万千」。剪纸最常见的颜色是红色，因为红色象征喜庆吉祥。逢年过节，人们把剪纸贴在门窗上烘托气氛。2009年，中国剪纸被联合国教科文组织列入人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录，受到各国关注。
passages.en: Paper cutting is one of the most popular traditional folk arts in China, with a history of about 1,500 years. Using only a pair of scissors and a piece of paper, people can cut out various patterns, such as flowers, birds, fish, insects, and scenes of figures and stories. It is truly a small square of paper that holds a whole world. The most common color of paper cutting is red, because red stands for joy and good luck in Chinese culture. During festivals, people stick paper cuttings on windows and doors to create a festive atmosphere. In 2009, Chinese paper cutting was added by UNESCO to the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity, drawing attention from all over the world. Today, paper cutting has entered schools and communities, and more and more young people begin to learn this skill. Some artists also combine it with modern design, giving this ancient art new vitality and showing the unique charm of folk art.

terms.note: 固定译法，也可写 paper-cut art
固定官方译法
通用缩写，全称 United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization
并列四字词用简单名词降级处理
四字格直列名词即可，顺序照原文

tips: 「方寸之间，气象万千」是难点，可意译为 a small square of paper that holds a whole world，不必逐字对应。
「2009年，……被列入……名录」用被动句 was added by UNESCO to... 处理，年份和机构信息一个都不能丢。

passages.title: 京剧
passages.zh: 京剧是中国的国粹，形成于清代乾隆年间，至今已有两百多年历史。它集唱、念、做、打于一体，是一门综合性舞台艺术。京剧脸谱色彩丰富：红色代表忠勇，白色象征奸诈，黑色表示刚直。2010年，京剧被列入人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录。近年来，许多演员尝试把传统剧目与现代元素相结合，吸引了大批年轻观众，使这门古老艺术焕发出新的生机。
passages.en: Peking Opera is the national treasure of Chinese theater. It took shape during the reign of Emperor Qianlong in the Qing Dynasty and has a history of more than two hundred years. It combines the best of local opera traditions and brings together singing, speaking, acting, and martial arts, making it a comprehensive stage art. The facial makeup of Peking Opera uses rich colors with different meanings: red stands for loyalty and bravery, white suggests treachery, and black shows uprightness. Each role type has its own singing style and acting pattern, so the audience can tell a character's identity and personality at a glance. In 2010, Peking Opera was included in the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity. In recent years, many performers have tried to combine classic plays with modern elements, attracting large numbers of young viewers. Peking Opera is loved not only by Chinese people but also performs abroad many times, showing the depth of Chinese culture on the world stage.

terms.note: 固定译法，也可写 Beijing Opera
朝代：the + 拼音 + Dynasty
京剧术语通用译法

terms.en: singing, speaking, acting, and martial arts
terms.note: 四字专业词逐项意译

terms.zh: 非物质文化遗产代表作名录
terms.en: the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity
terms.note: 官方固定译名，可简化为 the Intangible Cultural Heritage list

tips: 「形成于清代乾隆年间」可用 during the reign of Emperor Qianlong in the Qing Dynasty，避免纠结年号字面。
脸谱三色排比句用冒号引出 red/white/black 三个并列短句，结构清楚且信息无遗漏。

passages.title: 中医针灸
passages.zh: 针灸是中医学的重要组成部分，已有两千多年的临床实践历史。它由针法和灸法两部分组成，通过刺激人体特定穴位来调节气血、疏通经络，从而达到治病养生的目的。2010年，中医针灸被联合国教科文组织列入人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录。如今，针灸已传播到一百八十多个国家和地区，受到越来越多的认可，并将继续为人类健康作出贡献。
passages.en: Acupuncture and moxibustion is an important part of traditional Chinese medicine and has a history of more than two thousand years of clinical practice. It consists of two parts: needle therapy and moxibustion. By stimulating specific points on the human body, it regulates the flow of blood and energy and opens the channels, so as to treat diseases and keep the body healthy. The theoretical basis of this therapy is the channel system, which holds that a network of channels runs through the human body. In 2010, acupuncture and moxibustion of traditional Chinese medicine were added by UNESCO to the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity, becoming a window for the world to understand Chinese culture. Today, it has spread to more than 180 countries and regions and is increasingly recognized worldwide. The World Health Organization believes that it works clearly against many diseases. With deeper medical exchanges between China and other countries, this ancient therapy will continue to contribute to human health.

terms.note: 针=acupuncture，灸=moxibustion，合写更严谨
固定缩写 TCM
通俗语境用 points 即可
学术译 meridians，通俗译 channels 更易懂
机构名用通用译法加缩写

tips: 「调节气血、疏通经络」不要直译 qi 和 blood，降级为 regulates the flow of blood and energy and opens the channels，通顺优先。
「从而达到……的目的」处理为 so as to do 或 in order to do 即可，不必保留「目的」字面。

passages.title: 汉服
passages.zh: 汉服是汉民族的传统服饰，可追溯至黄帝时期，延续数千年而不衰。其显著特征是交领右衽、宽袍大袖，体现了古人「天人合一」的哲学思想和含蓄优雅的审美取向。不同朝代的汉服各有特色：唐代的襦裙艳丽华美，宋代的褙子简洁端庄，明代的袄裙雍容大气。近年来，越来越多年轻人穿上汉服走上街头，形成独特的「汉服热」，展现着青年的文化自信。
passages.en: Hanfu is the traditional clothing of the Han ethnic group, also known as Han garments. Its history can be traced back to the time of the Yellow Emperor and has lasted for several thousand years. Hanfu is marked by a cross-collar on the right side and wide robes with long sleeves, reflecting the ancient philosophy of harmony between man and nature and a taste for subtle elegance. Hanfu varied across dynasties: the skirts of the Tang Dynasty were bright and gorgeous, the beizi jackets of the Song Dynasty were simple and dignified, and the aoqun outfits of the Ming Dynasty looked grand and graceful. In history, Hanfu deeply influenced the clothing culture of neighboring countries. In recent years, with the revival of traditional culture, more and more young people wear Hanfu on the streets and organize Hanfu activities on their own, creating a unique craze for Hanfu. Hanfu is more than a piece of clothing. It carries the cultural memory and identity of the Chinese nation and has become a way for young people to express cultural confidence.

terms.note: 直接用拼音，已通用
固定文化译法

terms.en: a cross-collar on the right side
terms.note: 术语意译，说清领口特征即可
常见意译，也可写 the unity of man and nature

terms.en: the Tang Dynasty / the Song Dynasty / the Ming Dynasty
terms.note: 朝代统一用 the + 拼音 + Dynasty

terms.en: ruqun skirts / beizi jackets / aoqun outfits
terms.note: 服饰名词拼音+类别词，简单明了

tips: 「交领右衽、宽袍大袖」这类服装术语不要硬译单字，用 a cross-collar on the right side and wide robes with long sleeves 描述外观即可。
三个朝代排比句用 varied across dynasties 总起加冒号，逐个朝代对应一种服饰一种风格，避免长定语嵌套。

passages.title: 围棋
passages.zh: 围棋起源于中国，相传已有四千多年历史，被誉为「棋类之王」。棋盘纵横各十九路，共三百六十一个交叉点，黑白两色棋子交替落子，以围地多少决定胜负。围棋规则看似简单，实则变化无穷，古人常用「千古无同局」来形容其博大精深。唐代时，围棋传入日本和朝鲜半岛，随后传播到世界各地。随着人工智能程序战胜人类顶尖棋手，围棋再次引起全球关注。
passages.en: Weiqi, also known as Go, originated in China. Legend has it that the game has a history of more than four thousand years and is honored as the king of board games. The board has nineteen lines in each direction and 361 crossing points in total. Players of black and white take turns placing stones, and the winner is decided by the amount of territory surrounded. The rules look simple, but the game offers endless variations; ancient people said that no two games have ever been the same. Weiqi is more than a competitive game; it also carries deep philosophy: every placed stone cannot be taken back, which stands for firm decision, and giving up small gains for bigger ones shows wisdom. In the Tang Dynasty, Weiqi spread to Japan and the Korean Peninsula, and later to the rest of the world. Today, top players keep appearing in China, Japan, and South Korea, and professional matches are full of excitement. After artificial intelligence programs defeated the world's best human players, Weiqi drew global attention once again, and more teenagers begin to learn this ancient and wise game.

terms.note: 中国语境用拼音 Weiqi，国际通用 Go
围棋棋子固定译 stones
朝代：the + 拼音 + Dynasty
地名通用译法
缩写 AI

tips: 「千古无同局」这类文言说法不直译，用 that no two games have ever been the same 转述成英语谚语式表达。
「落子无悔象征决断，舍小取大体现智慧，审时度势考验胸怀」三连排比，拆成三个独立短句，每句用 which/动名词引出哲理，主谓完整。

passages.title: 二十四节气
passages.zh: 二十四节气是中国古代订立的一种补充历法，用来指导农事，已有两千多年历史。它将一年分为二十四段，每段约十五天，反映季节、气候和物候的变化。民间形成了相应习俗，如立春吃春饼、冬至吃饺子。在国际气象界，二十四节气被誉为「中国的第五大发明」。2016年，它被列入联合国教科文组织人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录，至今影响人们的生活。
passages.en: The Twenty-Four Solar Terms are a supplementary calendar created in ancient China to guide farming, with a history of more than two thousand years. The year is divided into twenty-four periods, each lasting about fifteen days, reflecting changes in seasons, climate, and natural phenomena. Farmers arrange sowing, fertilizing, and harvesting according to the terms, while folk customs about food, rituals, and health care have formed around them, such as eating spring pancakes at the Beginning of Spring and dumplings at the Winter Solstice. In the international meteorological community, the Twenty-Four Solar Terms are praised as China's fifth greatest invention. In 2016, they were inscribed by UNESCO on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity. Today, although farming methods have changed greatly, the solar terms still shape people's lives. Qingming is both a solar term and a traditional festival for honoring ancestors, and people still follow the custom of welcoming spring at the Beginning of Spring, showing the lasting vitality of this ancient calendar.

terms.note: 官方通用译法，首字母大写
节气意译名，the + 意译
固定译法
兼有节日义时可写 Qingming Festival
降级意译，也可用 phenology（较专业）

tips: 节气名称属于官方约定译名，用 the Beginning of Spring、the Winter Solstice 这类意译，不要自己造词。
「清明既是节气又是……节日」用 is both a solar term and a traditional festival 处理，突出双重身份。

passages.title: 皮影戏
passages.zh: 皮影戏是用灯光照射兽皮或纸板做成的人物剪影来表演故事的民间戏剧，起源于西汉时期，已有两千多年历史，是最早的「电影」之一。表演时，艺人在幕布后操纵影人，配以唱腔和乐器，影人栩栩如生。皮影融绘画、雕刻、戏曲等艺术于一体，各地风格迥异。2011年入选人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录，如今通过进校园、开直播等方式吸引年轻观众。
passages.en: Shadow play is a folk theater in which stories are performed through figures cut from animal skin or paperboard and projected by lamplight. It originated in the Western Han Dynasty and has a history of more than two thousand years, making it one of the earliest forms of film in the world. During a show, artists behind a white screen move the figures while singing and playing musical instruments, and the figures seem to come alive. The figures are beautifully made and combine painting, carving, and opera. Styles vary from place to place: northern shadow play looks bold and rough, while southern shadow play appears delicate and fine. In 2011, Chinese shadow play was inscribed by UNESCO on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity. However, with the rise of modern entertainment, its audience is shrinking, and many skills are in danger of dying out. In recent years, through entering campuses, making animated films, and hosting live streams, this ancient art is trying new ways to win young viewers and keep its thousand-year stories alive between light and shadow.

terms.note: 通用译法，也可写 shadow puppetry
朝代分东西时用 Western/Eastern + 拼音 + Dynasty
指皮影人物，用 figures 简单表达

terms.zh: 入选非物质文化遗产名录
terms.en: be inscribed on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage
terms.note: inscribe on 为官方固定搭配

terms.en: be in danger of dying out
terms.note: 固定短语，也可用 be lost forever

tips: 「世界上最早的『电影』之一」的引号表明是比喻，译时用 one of the earliest forms of film 表达即可，不必保留引号。
首句定义较长，用 in which 引导定语从句把「灯光照射剪影」说清楚，避免多个动词堆叠；后文再补充历史信息。

passages.title: 长城
passages.zh: 长城是世界闻名的古代防御工程，也是中华民族的象征。它始建于两千多年前的春秋战国时期，秦始皇统一中国后把各段城墙连接起来。此后历代不断修筑，其中大部分现存长城是明代修建的。长城东起山海关，西至嘉峪关，全长约两万千米。如今，长城每年吸引数百万中外游客，1987年被列入《世界遗产名录》。
passages.en: The Great Wall is a world-famous ancient defense project and a symbol of the Chinese nation. Its construction began more than 2,000 years ago, during the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period. After unifying China, the First Emperor of Qin linked the separate walls together. Later dynasties kept rebuilding it, and most of the wall standing today dates from the Ming Dynasty. Stretching from Shanhaiguan in the east to Jiayuguan in the west, the wall is about 20,000 kilometers long. Today it attracts millions of visitors from home and abroad every year, and it was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1987.

terms.note: 注意 defense 的拼写

terms.en: the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period
terms.note: 两个时期并列，常考
固定译法，避免逐字 Qin Shihuang
朝代译法：the + 拼音 + Dynasty
联合国教科文组织 UNESCO 评定

tips: “始建于……时期”先译 began 再补 during... 作时间状语，不要硬塞成一句
朝代名用 the + 拼音 + Dynasty 的模式，山海关、嘉峪关这类地名直接写拼音即可

passages.title: 故宫
passages.zh: 故宫又称紫禁城，位于北京市中心，是明清两代的皇家宫殿。它始建于1406年，历时十四年建成，共有宫殿七十多座、房屋九千余间。故宫建筑群沿南北中轴线对称分布，红墙黄瓦，气势恢宏，集中体现了中国古代建筑艺术的高度成就。1925年，故宫成为博物馆，如今收藏着一百八十多万件文物，是中国收藏文物最多的博物馆。
passages.en: The Palace Museum, also known as the Forbidden City, is located in the center of Beijing. It served as the imperial palace of the Ming and Qing dynasties. Its construction began in 1406 and took fourteen years to complete. The complex has more than seventy palaces and over nine thousand rooms. The buildings are arranged symmetrically along a central north-south axis, with red walls and yellow glazed tiles, which fully demonstrates the great achievements of ancient Chinese architecture. In 1925 it became a museum, and today it houses over 1.8 million cultural relics, making it the museum with the largest collection in China.

terms.note: 景点名用 the Palace Museum；建筑群用 the Forbidden City
对称分布 arranged symmetrically
glazed 指琉璃釉
可数，常用复数

tips: “又称紫禁城”用 also known as 插入语，一句话交代两个名字
最后一句“是收藏最多的博物馆”用 making it... 分词结构收尾，比再写一个 which 从句更简洁

passages.title: 秦始皇陵兵马俑
passages.zh: 秦始皇陵兵马俑位于陕西省西安市，是秦始皇陵的陪葬坑，1974年被当地农民发现。目前已发掘三个俑坑，出土陶俑、陶马约八千件，与真人真马大小相当。1987年，秦始皇陵及兵马俑坑被联合国教科文组织列入《世界遗产名录》，被誉为“世界第八大奇迹”，每年吸引数百万中外游客前来参观。
passages.en: The Terracotta Army is located in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, and serves as the burial pits of the Mausoleum of Emperor Qin Shi Huang of the Qin Dynasty. It was discovered in 1974 by local farmers digging a well. So far, three pits have been excavated, yielding about 8,000 life-sized terracotta soldiers and horses. Each figure has a unique face, hairstyle, and uniform, vividly reflecting the army of the Qin Dynasty more than two thousand years ago. In 1987, the mausoleum and the Terracotta Army pits were inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List. Known as the Eighth Wonder of the World, the site attracts millions of visitors from China and abroad every year. It is also regarded as one of the greatest archaeological discoveries of the twentieth century, providing valuable evidence for the study of ancient Chinese military history, art, and craftsmanship. Ongoing excavation and restoration work continues to reveal new finds to this day.

terms.note: 约定俗成译法，通常不必逐字翻译“秦始皇陵”
名词作定语，用复数形式

terms.en: be inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List
terms.note: 固定搭配，用被动语态

terms.en: the Eighth Wonder of the World
terms.note: 序数词前加定冠词 the
用合成形容词 life-sized 简洁表达

tips: 中文长定语拆译：把“是秦始皇陵的陪葬坑”独立成句，主句用 and 连接，避免头重脚轻。
数字表达统一用阿拉伯数字加单位（8,000 life-sized soldiers），全文人称、时态保持一致。

passages.title: 杭州西湖
passages.zh: 杭州西湖位于浙江杭州西部，湖面面积约6.4平方公里，是中国著名的淡水湖泊。西湖以“三面云山一面城”闻名，苏堤、白堤将湖面分隔成若干部分，形成“一山、二塔、三岛、三堤、五湖”的格局。2011年，“杭州西湖文化景观”被联合国教科文组织列入《世界遗产名录》。文人墨客在此留下诗篇，白蛇传等民间传说为西湖增添浪漫色彩。
passages.en: West Lake lies in the west of Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, and covers an area of about 6.4 square kilometers. It is one of the most famous freshwater lakes in China. The lake is known for its beautiful landscape of hills on three sides and the city on the fourth. The Su Causeway and the Bai Causeway, built in honor of the poet Su Shi and the poet Bai Juyi, divide the water into several parts, forming the classic layout of one hill, two pagodas, three islands, three causeways, and five lakes. In 2011, the West Lake Cultural Landscape of Hangzhou was added to the UNESCO World Heritage List. For more than a thousand years, poets and writers have composed countless verses about the lake, and folk legends such as the story of the White Snake add a romantic charm to its scenery. Blending natural scenery with human culture harmoniously, West Lake is often praised as a paradise on earth.

terms.note: 约定俗成译法，前面加 the 时用 the West Lake
纪念苏轼而名，causeway 指湖堤
纪念白居易而名
四字格意译，不必逐字对应

terms.en: the story of the White Snake
terms.note: 民间传说用 the story of... 引出

tips: 四字格“三面云山一面城”拆译为 of 介词短语：hills on three sides and the city on the fourth。
并列数字格局“一山、二塔……”直译为 one hill, two pagodas... 并保持平行结构。

passages.title: 黄山
passages.zh: 黄山位于安徽省南部，主峰莲花峰海拔1864米，是中国著名的山岳风景区。黄山以奇松、怪石、云海、温泉、冬雪“五绝”闻名于世，素有“五岳归来不看山，黄山归来不看岳”之说。1990年，黄山被联合国教科文组织列入《世界遗产名录》，成为世界文化与自然双重遗产。明代旅行家徐霞客曾两次游览黄山，赞叹“登黄山，天下无山”。
passages.en: Mount Huangshan is located in southern Anhui Province, and its highest peak, Lotus Peak, stands 1,864 meters above sea level. It is one of the most famous mountain scenic areas in China. The mountain is renowned for its five wonders: oddly shaped pines, strange rocks, the sea of clouds, hot springs, and winter snow. A famous Chinese saying goes that after seeing the Five Great Mountains, no other mountains are worth seeing, and after Mount Huangshan, even the Five Great Mountains are not worth seeing. In 1990, Mount Huangshan was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List as a mixed cultural and natural heritage site. Xu Xiake, a traveler of the Ming Dynasty, visited the mountain twice and praised it as the finest mountain under heaven. Today, it attracts millions of hikers and photographers from all over the world every year. It is also popularly known as the most marvelous mountain in China.

terms.note: 山名用 Mount + 拼音
意译峰名，Peak 首字母大写

terms.zh: 奇松、怪石、云海、温泉、冬雪
terms.en: oddly shaped pines, strange rocks, the sea of clouds, hot springs, and winter snow
terms.note: 五个并列名词短语保持平行结构
约定译法，加定冠词 the

terms.zh: 世界文化与自然双重遗产
terms.en: a mixed cultural and natural heritage site
terms.note: 世界遗产官方表述用 mixed

tips: 俗语“五岳归来不看山……”用 A saying goes that... 引出从句，避免直译造成英文不通。
“素有……之说”用被动句式 is renowned for 处理，避免与后文重复。

passages.title: 苏州园林
passages.zh: 苏州园林是中国古典园林的杰出代表，多建于明清两代，现存园林五十余处。其中拙政园、留园等九处园林于1997年和2000年先后被联合国教科文组织列入《世界遗产名录》。苏州园林以小巧精致著称，讲究“虽由人作，宛自天开”的艺术效果，通过山水花木与亭台的巧妙布局，在有限空间内营造出无穷意境，被誉为“咫尺之内再造乾坤”。
passages.en: The classical gardens of Suzhou are outstanding examples of traditional Chinese garden design. Most of them were built during the Ming and Qing dynasties, and more than fifty gardens survive today. In 1997 and 2000, nine of these gardens, including the Humble Administrator's Garden, the Lingering Garden, the Master of the Nets Garden, and the Mountain Villa with Embracing Beauty, were inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List. Suzhou gardens are famous for their small size and exquisite detail. Their designers followed the artistic principle that although the gardens are man-made, they should look naturally created. With cleverly arranged rockeries, ponds, flowers, trees, pavilions, and terraces, they create endless artistic effects within limited space, which has been praised as recreating the whole universe within an inch. Stepping into one of these gardens, visitors feel as if they were walking through a living scroll of classical Chinese painting, and such designs have influenced gardens far beyond Suzhou.

terms.note: 约定俗成译名，注意所有格
约定俗成译名

terms.en: the Master of the Nets Garden
terms.note: 约定俗成译名
园林术语，用 rockery 的复数

terms.en: although man-made, they should look naturally created
terms.note: 意译成语，突出人工与自然的辩证关系

tips: “多建于明清两代”用被动语态 most of them were built during the Ming and Qing dynasties，朝代前加 the。
引文“虽由人作，宛自天开”处理为 principle 的同位语从句，用 although 引导让步关系。

passages.title: 敦煌莫高窟
passages.zh: 敦煌莫高窟位于甘肃敦煌东南25公里的鸣沙山东麓，始建于公元366年，是世界上规模最大的佛教艺术宝库之一。石窟群南北绵延约1600米，现存洞窟735个、壁画4.5万平方米、彩塑2400余身。1987年，莫高窟被联合国教科文组织列入《世界遗产名录》。二十世纪初藏经洞文物的发现催生了“敦煌学”，使敦煌成为世界学术重镇。
passages.en: The Mogao Grottoes are situated at the eastern foot of the Mingsha Mountains, 25 kilometers southeast of Dunhuang in Gansu Province. Their construction began in 366 AD, which makes them one of the largest treasure houses of Buddhist art in the world. The grottoes stretch about 1,600 meters from north to south and contain 735 caves, 45,000 square meters of murals, and more than 2,400 painted sculptures. In 1987, the Mogao Grottoes were inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List. At the beginning of the twentieth century, the discovery of the cultural relics from the Library Cave gave birth to Dunhuang Studies, turning Dunhuang into a major center of academic attention worldwide. The murals depict Buddhist scriptures, folk life, and the music and dance of ancient times, offering priceless material for research. Today, the grottoes stand as a living witness to a thousand years of cultural exchange along the Silk Road.

terms.note: 约定俗成译法，grotto 指石窟
地名用拼音，意译可注 the Singing Sand Mountains
敦煌学界约定译名
石窟艺术常用术语
突出“彩绘”特征
学科名首字母大写，用复数 Studies

tips: “始建于公元366年”用 construction began in 366 AD，避免逐字直译“始建”。
多个并列数据（洞窟、壁画、彩塑）用 contain A, B, and C 的平行结构一次带出，层次分明。

passages.title: 布达拉宫
passages.zh: 布达拉宫坐落于西藏拉萨的红山之巅，是集宫殿、城堡和寺院于一体的宏伟建筑群。布达拉宫始建于公元7世纪吐蕃赞普松赞干布时期，17世纪五世达赖喇嘛时期重建，此后长期作为历代达赖喇嘛的冬宫。宫殿高117米，共13层，建筑面积约13万平方米，拥有房间两千余间。1994年，布达拉宫被联合国教科文组织列入《世界遗产名录》。
passages.en: The Potala Palace stands on the top of the Red Hill in Lhasa, the capital of the Tibet Autonomous Region. It is a magnificent architectural complex that combines the functions of a palace, a fortress, and a monastery. The palace was first built in the seventh century during the reign of Songtsen Gampo, king of the Tubo Kingdom, and was rebuilt in the seventeenth century under the Fifth Dalai Lama. It then served for centuries as the winter palace of successive Dalai Lamas. The palace stands 117 meters high, with thirteen stories and a floor space of about 130,000 square meters, containing more than 2,000 rooms of different sizes. In 1994, the Potala Palace was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List. Every year, pilgrims and tourists from all over the world visit this sacred landmark, which is regarded as a symbol of Tibetan culture and a masterpiece of world architecture.

terms.note: 约定俗成译法
藏族人名按约定拼音转写
序数词修饰时用 the Fifth Dalai Lama
与夏宫 the summer palace 对应
“集宫殿、城堡和寺院于一体”意译为 combine 结构

tips: “始建于……时期”与“……时期重建”合并为两个被动句 was first built... and was rebuilt...，时间层次更清晰。
建筑数据（高117米、13层、13万平方米）用 with 独立主格结构带出，避免多个短句堆叠。

passages.title: 泰山
passages.zh: 泰山位于山东省中部，主峰玉皇顶海拔1545米，素有“五岳之首”的美誉。自古以来，泰山便是帝王封禅祭天、百姓祈福朝拜的圣地，先后有十三位帝王亲临泰山举行封禅大典。山中现存碑碣石刻两千余处，其中秦代李斯碑距今已有两千二百多年历史。1987年，泰山被联合国教科文组织列为世界文化与自然双重遗产，成为首例获此殊荣的世界遗产项目。
passages.en: Mount Tai lies in central Shandong Province, and its main peak, the Jade Emperor Peak, rises 1,545 meters above sea level. It has long enjoyed the reputation of being the foremost of the Five Great Mountains of China. Since ancient times, Mount Tai has been a sacred place where emperors held grand Fengshan ceremonies to worship Heaven and where ordinary people came to pray for blessings. Thirteen emperors in Chinese history personally climbed the mountain to perform these ceremonies. The mountain preserves more than 2,000 stone inscriptions, among which the stele inscribed by Li Si of the Qin Dynasty dates back over 2,200 years. In 1987, Mount Tai was listed by UNESCO as a World Cultural and Natural Heritage site, becoming the first such site in the world to receive this double honor. Climbing its ancient stone steps, visitors from home and abroad can still feel the weight of history and culture it carries.

terms.note: 山名约定译法
意译峰名
特有文化词用拼音加注，特指时可用 ceremony 说明
合并意译，指山上历代刻石

terms.en: the stele inscribed by Li Si
terms.note: 用过去分词短语作后置定语

tips: “帝王封禅祭天、百姓祈福朝拜的圣地”用 where 引导的定语从句展开，一句涵盖两层主语。
文化专有词“封禅”保留拼音 Fengshan 并加 ceremony 解释，体现“音译+类别词”的翻译策略。

passages.title: 张家界
passages.zh: 张家界国家森林公园地处湖南西北部武陵山区，1982年设立，是中国第一个国家森林公园，总面积约4810公顷。公园以砂岩峰林地貌闻名，拥有形态各异的石峰三千余座，其中黄石寨、袁家界等景区景色壮丽。电影《阿凡达》中“哈利路亚山”原型取材于此。1992年，武陵源风景名胜区（含张家界）被联合国教科文组织列入《世界遗产名录》。
passages.en: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park is located in the Wuling Mountains in northwestern Hunan Province. Officially established in 1982, it was the first national forest park in China, covering a total area of about 4,810 hectares. The park is renowned for its unique sandstone peak forest landform, with more than 3,000 stone peaks of various shapes rising above deep valleys and steep cliffs. Among them, the scenic areas of Huangshizhai and Yuanjiajie offer the most spectacular views. The floating Hallelujah Mountain in the film Avatar was inspired by these peaks. In 1992, the Wulingyuan Scenic Area, which includes Zhangjiajie, was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List. Today, the park attracts millions of visitors every year. With its misty peaks, deep canyons, and dense forests, it has become a world-famous destination for nature lovers and photographers from around the world. Rare plants and animals, such as the Chinese macaque, also thrive in its well-protected ecosystem.

terms.note: 专名各成分首字母大写
地理学术语，名词作定语
约定译名
景区名直接用拼音
景区名直接用拼音
电影名斜体书写，正文常用 the film Avatar 提示

tips: “1982年设立，是中国第一个国家森林公园”用过去分词短语 Officially established in 1982 开头，突出主句信息。
“峰峦叠嶂、沟壑纵横”不逐字硬译，用 with 引导的介词短语浓缩为 with... deep valleys, and steep cliffs。

passages.title: 餐桌礼仪
passages.zh: 在中国，请客吃饭有许多讲究。客人入座时，通常请长者或贵宾坐上座。吃饭时，主人会主动给客人夹菜，以示热情，但客人不必把盘子里的菜全部吃完。使用筷子也有一些禁忌：不能把筷子插在饭碗里，也不能用筷子指着别人。碰杯时，晚辈的杯子要略低于长辈的，以表示尊敬。这些礼仪体现了中国人尊老爱幼的传统美德。
passages.en: In China, there are many customs to follow when treating guests to dinner. When guests are seated, the elderly or the most honored guest is usually offered the seat of honor. During the meal, the host picks up food for the guests to show hospitality, but guests are not expected to finish everything on their plates. There are also taboos about using chopsticks: never stick them upright in a bowl of rice, and never point them at others. When clinking glasses, the younger people hold their glasses slightly lower than those of the elders as a sign of respect. These manners reflect the Chinese tradition of respecting the old and caring for the young.

terms.note: honor 美式拼写，honour 亦可
口语化也可用 serve food to
可数名词，复数 taboos

terms.en: respect the old and care for the young
terms.note: 对仗结构，可直接背

tips: 全篇祈使句禁令用 never + 动词原形，比 You should not 更利落
“以示……”统一用 to show / as a sign of 两个短语处理，避免重复

passages.title: 传统婚礼
passages.zh: 中国传统婚礼以红色为主色调，象征喜庆和吉祥。婚礼前，新郎要上门迎娶新娘，新人向双方父母敬茶，父母则回赠红包或首饰，表示接纳和祝福。婚宴上，新人挨桌向宾客敬酒，感谢他们的到来。随着时代变迁，许多年轻人选择把传统仪式与现代元素结合起来，例如旅行结婚或举办户外婚礼，但敬茶和敬酒等环节仍然被保留下来。
passages.en: A traditional Chinese wedding features red as its main color, which symbolizes joy and good fortune. Before the ceremony, the groom comes to fetch the bride, and the couple serve tea to both sets of parents, who give red envelopes or jewelry in return to show acceptance and blessings. At the banquet, the newlyweds go from table to table, toasting the guests and thanking them for coming. With the times changing, many young people choose to combine traditional rituals with modern elements, such as a destination wedding or an outdoor ceremony. However, rituals like serving tea and toasting are still kept today.

terms.note: feature 作动词“以……为特色”
一对新人 the couple / the newlyweds
serve 比 respectfully offer 更自然
set 表示“（亲属的）一家”

tips: 全篇用一般现在时描述习俗，不要时态混乱
“旅行结婚”不会直译就写 get married while traveling，意思到位即可

passages.title: 中秋节
passages.zh: 中秋节是中国的传统节日，时间在农历八月十五。这一天月亮又圆又亮，象征团圆，因此又称团圆节。傍晚，全家人聚在一起吃团圆饭，饭后一起到院子里赏月。月饼是必不可少的食物，圆圆的月饼寓意全家团圆和睦。人们一边吃月饼，一边听长辈讲嫦娥奔月的故事。许多地方还会挂起灯笼、举办灯会。在外的人不管多忙，也尽量赶回家过节。
passages.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a traditional Chinese festival. It falls on the fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month, when the moon is at its fullest and brightest. Because the full moon symbolizes reunion, the festival is also called the Reunion Festival. In the evening, family members get together for a reunion dinner. After the meal, they sit in the yard and admire the moon. Mooncakes are an essential food for the festival. Their round shape stands for family unity and harmony. While eating mooncakes, people listen to the elders tell the story of Chang'e flying to the moon. In many places, people also hang colorful lanterns and hold lantern fairs. No matter how busy they are, people who work far away try their best to return home for the festival. Today, the Mid-Autumn Festival remains one of the most beloved festivals in China. It is an important occasion for family reunion and for expressing love and longing.

terms.note: 固定译法，需加定冠词
常作名词，如 family reunion
合成词，可写 moon cake
admire 含欣赏之意
中国神话人名用拼音

tips: 农历日期译法：on the fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month，注意序数词和 lunar month 的搭配。
象征意义的处理：可用 symbolize / stand for 引出寓意，避免逐字硬译。

passages.title: 压岁钱
passages.zh: 压岁钱是中国春节的一项重要习俗。除夕之夜，长辈把红包送给孩子，里面装着寓意平安吉祥的钱，这就是压岁钱。压岁本意是压住邪祟，祝愿孩子在新的一年里健康平安。如今红包用红色信封包好，因为在中国文化中红色代表喜庆和好运。随着电子支付普及，不少家庭开始用微信发送电子红包，形式变了，祝福的心意没有变。这一习俗体现了中国人重视家庭。
passages.en: Lucky money is an important custom of the Chinese Spring Festival. On Chinese New Year's Eve, elders give children red envelopes filled with money that carries wishes for safety and good fortune. This money is known as lucky money. Its original meaning was to suppress evil spirits and wish children health and peace in the coming year. Today, the money is usually wrapped in red envelopes, because red stands for joy and good luck in Chinese culture. With the spread of electronic payment, many families now send digital red envelopes through apps such as WeChat. The form has changed, but the blessing behind it remains the same. The amount of money does not really matter. What matters is the elders' love and care for the younger generation. This custom has been passed down for generations and reflects the Chinese tradition of valuing family. Children are always happy to receive these red envelopes from their elders.

terms.note: 也可译 gift money，lucky money 更常用
电子红包为 digital red envelope
固定表达
即新年行礼问候
auspicious 意为吉祥的

tips: 长句拆译：中文流水句可拆成多个短句，每句主谓完整，如 The form has changed, but the blessing remains.
无主句处理：如「金额多少并不重要」可用 it 形式主语译出：What matters is...

passages.title: 十二生肖
passages.zh: 十二生肖是中国特有的纪年方式，由鼠、牛、虎、兔、龙、蛇、马、羊、猴、鸡、狗、猪十二种动物组成。每个人出生的年份都对应一种动物，称为属相。中国人常用生肖推算年龄，也喜欢用它谈论性格和命运。比如，人们认为属龙的人勇敢，属羊的人温和。生肖还与婚恋习俗有关，过去有些家庭会看双方的属相是否相配。
passages.en: The Chinese zodiac is a unique way of recording years in China. It consists of twelve animals: the rat, the ox, the tiger, the rabbit, the dragon, the snake, the horse, the goat, the monkey, the rooster, the dog and the pig. The animal connected with a person's birth year is called his or her zodiac sign. Chinese people often use the zodiac to work out someone's age, and they also talk about personality and fortune with it. For example, people born in the Year of the Dragon are believed to be brave, while those born in the Year of the Goat are considered gentle. The zodiac is also related to marriage customs. In the past, some families would check whether the two signs of a couple matched. The zodiac culture has a history of more than two thousand years and still plays an important role in daily life even today.

terms.note: zodiac sign 指个人属相
问属相：What's your zodiac sign?
生肖年用 Year of the + 动物
work out 意为推算出
此处指属相相合

tips: 列举十二种动物时用英语并列结构，前面加 the，最后一项前用 and。
生肖纪年的表达用 the Year of the + 动物名词，注意动物名词小写。

passages.title: 舞龙舞狮
passages.zh: 舞龙舞狮是中国民间传统表演艺术，历史悠久，深受百姓喜爱。每逢春节、元宵节等节日，人们便走上街头表演，欢庆佳节。舞龙时，十几名舞者举着一条长龙，随鼓点翻腾跳跃，气势磅礴。舞狮由两名舞者配合，一人舞狮头，一人舞狮尾，模仿狮子的各种神态。狮子在中国文化中象征吉祥，舞狮寓意驱邪纳福。高潮时狮子要登高采摘悬挂的彩球，称为采青。
passages.en: The dragon and lion dances are traditional Chinese folk performing arts with a long history, and they are deeply loved by ordinary people. During major festivals such as the Spring Festival and the Lantern Festival, performers take to the streets to celebrate. In the dragon dance, more than ten dancers hold up a long dragon. They make it rise and fall with the beat of drums, moving flexibly with great energy. The lion dance requires two dancers to work together. One dancer controls the lion's head, and the other controls its tail, imitating the animal's expressions. The lion is an auspicious animal in Chinese culture, and the lion dance is meant to drive away evil and bring good fortune. At the climax of the performance, the lion climbs up to pick a hanging colorful ball. This act is called cai qing, which means plucking the greens, a symbol of gathering wealth. Today, these dances have spread all over the world. They have become an important window for showing Chinese culture, and many overseas Chinese communities organize performances during festivals.

terms.note: 常用复数形式
固定译法

terms.en: drive away evil and bring good fortune
terms.note: 并列动词结构
音译加简要解释
可指人或社团

tips: 四字格的翻译策略：如「驱邪纳福」拆为 drive away evil and bring good fortune，不必追求结构对仗。
中文无主句（如「一人舞狮头」）补出主语 one dancer / the other 使句子完整。

passages.title: 端午节
passages.zh: 端午节是中国传统节日，在农历五月初五，已有两千多年历史。节日最广为人知的起源与爱国诗人屈原有关。相传屈原投江后，人们划船打捞他的身体，并往江中投放粽子，以免鱼虾啃食，久而久之形成了赛龙舟和吃粽子的习俗。粽子用箬叶包裹糯米和馅料制成，南北口味各异，北甜南咸。2009年，端午节被列入人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录。
passages.en: The Dragon Boat Festival is a traditional Chinese festival that falls on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month. It has a history of more than two thousand years. The best-known origin of the festival is connected with Qu Yuan, a patriotic poet of ancient China. According to legend, after Qu Yuan drowned himself in a river, local people rowed boats to search for his body and threw rice dumplings into the water to keep fish and shrimp from eating him. Over time, these acts developed into the customs of dragon boat racing and eating zongzi. Zongzi are made of glutinous rice and various fillings wrapped in bamboo leaves. Tastes differ greatly between the north and the south: sweet zongzi are common in the north, while salty ones are preferred in the south. In 2009, the festival was inscribed on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity by UNESCO.

terms.note: 固定译法
音译加解释，也可用 rice dumplings
名词化的活动名称
glutinous 意为黏性的
UNESCO 官方术语

tips: 典故叙述宜用一般过去时加 According to legend 引出，与当代习俗的一般现在时区分开。
长句用分词或从句整合，如 thrown into the water to keep fish and shrimp from eating him，避免多个短句松散堆砌。

passages.title: 清明节
passages.zh: 清明节既是节气又是传统节日，一般在公历四月五日前后。清明节最重要的习俗是扫墓祭祖。人们携带鲜花、食品和纸钱前往祖先墓地，清扫墓碑，献上供品，表达追思之情。近年来，出于防火和环保考虑，许多地方提倡鲜花祭扫，网络祭扫也逐渐流行。清明还有荡秋千、放风筝等民俗活动。如今清明既是法定假日，也是人们缅怀先人、亲近自然的日子。
passages.en: The Qingming Festival, also known as Tomb-Sweeping Day, is both a solar term and a traditional festival. It usually falls around April fifth in the solar calendar, when spring returns and plants sprout. The most important custom of the festival is tomb sweeping. People visit the graves of their ancestors with fresh flowers, food offerings and joss paper. They clean the tombstones, present the offerings, and express their remembrance of the dead. In recent years, out of concerns about fire prevention and environmental protection, many places have encouraged using flowers instead of burning joss paper. Online memorial services have also become popular. The festival also features folk activities such as swinging and flying kites. Today, Qingming is a public holiday as well as a day for people to get close to nature and honor their ancestors. It reflects the Chinese cultural tradition of respecting the past and remembering one's roots.

terms.note: 两种译法均通用
祭祖为 honoring ancestors
也可用 offerings
传统祭祀用纸钱
春季郊游

tips: 一词多义的处理：清明既是节气又是节日，可用 both a solar term and a traditional festival 点明。
出于……考虑用 out of concerns about 引出原因，比 because of 更正式，适合六级表达。

passages.title: 重阳节
passages.zh: 重阳节在农历九月初九，因两个九相重而得名。在传统文化中，九是阳数之极，双九寓意吉祥长寿，因此重阳节也被视为敬老节。这一天人们登高望远，欣赏秋日景色，据说源于古人驱邪避灾的愿望。人们还会赏菊、饮菊花酒、吃重阳糕。重阳糕因糕与高同音，象征步步高升。如今重阳节被定为老年节，各地开展敬老活动，弘扬尊老敬老之风。
passages.en: The Double Ninth Festival falls on the ninth day of the ninth lunar month. It is named after the doubling of the number nine and is also called the Chongyang Festival. In traditional Chinese culture, nine is the highest yang number, and the double nine implies good fortune and longevity, so the festival is also regarded as a festival for respecting the elderly. On this day, people climb high to enjoy the autumn scenery. This custom is said to be related to ancient people's wish to drive away evil and avoid disaster. People also admire chrysanthemums, drink chrysanthemum wine, and eat Double Ninth cakes. The cake is a kind of pastry. Because the word for cake sounds the same as the word for high in Chinese, it symbolizes rising step by step in life. Today, the festival is officially designated as Senior Citizens' Day in China. Activities honoring the elderly are held across the country. Children accompany their parents on outings and dinners, and people from all walks of life visit and comfort elderly people who live alone. The social trend of respecting the elderly is becoming deeply rooted.

terms.note: 也可音译 the Chongyang Festival

terms.en: a festival for respecting the elderly
terms.note: 现亦称 Senior Citizens' Day
后常接 to enjoy the view
注意拼写
节日食品，音意结合

tips: 数字文化含义的解释性翻译：因两个九相重而得名，可补译为 It is named after the doubling of the number nine，让外国读者理解。
谐音双关的译法：点明 Because the word for cake sounds the same as the word for high，再加寓意，比直译更易懂。

passages.title: 庙会
passages.zh: 庙会是中国民间重要的传统民俗活动，通常在春节期间举行，因多与寺庙有关而得名。庙会起源于古代的祭祀活动，后逐渐演变为集商贸、娱乐和宗教文化于一体的民间盛会。庙会上人潮涌动，摊位沿街摆开，出售传统小吃、手工艺品和年货，叫卖声此起彼伏。民间艺人表演杂技、皮影戏、捏面人，令人目不暇接。不少庙会还有舞龙舞狮、踩高跷等巡游表演。
passages.en: The temple fair is an important traditional folk activity in China. It is usually held during the Spring Festival, or on the celebration days of temples, which gives the fair its name. Temple fairs originated from ancient sacrificial ceremonies. Over time, they evolved into grand folk gatherings that combined commerce, entertainment and religious culture. At a temple fair, crowds of people fill the streets, and all kinds of stalls line both sides, selling traditional snacks, handicrafts and holiday goods. Vendors call out their offers one after another. Folk artists give live performances such as acrobatics, shadow puppetry and dough figurine making, keeping visitors entertained and amazed. Many fairs also feature parade shows like dragon and lion dances and stilt walking, creating a lively atmosphere. Today, temple fairs serve both as places for shopping and recreation and as important carriers of folk culture. They are loved by citizens of all ages.

terms.note: 固定译法
指古代祭祀仪式
非物质文化遗产项目
传统民间手艺
民间巡游表演
指过节采购的物品

tips: 故而得名这类表达可用非限制性定语从句处理：which gives the fair its name，使行文衔接自然。
集……于一体译为 combined... into grand folk gatherings 或 featuring a mix of...，体现六级要求的句式整合能力。

passages.title: 高速铁路
passages.zh: 中国高铁的发展速度令世界瞩目。自2008年第一条高速铁路开通以来，中国已建成全球最大的高铁网络，营业里程超过四万千米。高铁把城市之间的旅行时间大大缩短，北京到上海最快只需四个半小时。高铁票价相对合理，车厢干净舒适，还覆盖了4G和5G网络，因此成为中国人出行的首选方式之一。中国高铁技术也已出口到多个国家，成为“中国制造”的一张名片。
passages.en: The rapid development of China's high-speed railway has attracted worldwide attention. Since the first high-speed line opened in 2008, China has built the largest high-speed rail network in the world, with more than 40,000 kilometers in operation. High-speed trains greatly shorten travel time between cities: the fastest journey from Beijing to Shanghai takes only four and a half hours. With reasonable fares, clean and comfortable carriages, and 4G and 5G network coverage, high-speed rail has become one of the preferred ways to travel in China. Chinese high-speed rail technology has also been exported to many countries, making it a name card of "Made in China".

terms.note: 也可用 gain worldwide attention
in operation 运营中
one of the preferred ways 之一
固定说法，加引号

tips: “令世界瞩目”这类评价语放句首总起，比直译 make the world focus on 自然得多
多项优点并列（票价、车厢、网络）用 With A, B, and C 结构一句搞定

passages.title: 移动支付
passages.zh: 在中国，移动支付已经深入到日常生活的方方面面。无论是商场购物、餐厅吃饭，还是乘坐公交、缴纳水电费，人们只需拿出手机扫一扫二维码即可完成支付。移动支付的普及得益于智能手机的广泛使用和成熟的网络基础设施。它不仅方便快捷，还减少了现金的使用。与此同时，一些老年人也开始学习使用智能手机，以便跟上数字时代的步伐。
passages.en: In China, mobile payment has become part of everyday life. Whether people are shopping in malls, dining in restaurants, taking buses or paying utility bills, they can complete the payment simply by taking out their phones and scanning a QR code. The popularity of mobile payment is thanks to the widespread use of smartphones and well-developed network infrastructure. It is not only convenient and efficient but also reduces the use of cash. Meanwhile, some elderly people have also started to learn how to use smartphones, so that they can keep up with the digital age.

terms.note: scan a QR code 扫码
utility 泛指水电气等公用事业
也可用 owe... to / benefit from
keep up with the digital age

tips: “无论……还是……”用 Whether... or... 引导让步状语从句，注意从句内语序
“以便”用 so that 引导目的状语从句，主句用 have started 现在完成时呼应“开始”

passages.title: 共享单车
passages.zh: 共享单车是近年来中国城市交通的一项重要创新。用户用手机扫描二维码即可解锁自行车，短距离出行十分方便。自2015年兴起以来，共享单车迅速发展，高峰期全国投放量超过两千万辆，日均使用上亿次。它解决了市民出行最后一公里的问题，减少了汽车尾气排放，促进了绿色出行，如今已推广到海外多个国家。
passages.en: Bike sharing is an important innovation in China's urban transportation in recent years. With a smartphone, users can simply scan a QR code to unlock a shared bicycle, which makes short-distance travel both cheap and convenient. Since the industry emerged in 2015, it has grown at remarkable speed. At its peak, more than 20 million shared bikes were in service across the country, and daily rides exceeded 100 million. Bike sharing effectively solves the problem of the last mile, the short journey between a public transport stop and one's final destination. At the same time, it replaces some car trips, reduces exhaust emissions and encourages green travel. Most rides cost only one or two yuan, far cheaper than taking a taxi. Today, bike sharing has become an essential part of the public transport system in most Chinese cities. Some Chinese bike-sharing companies have also expanded into overseas markets, bringing this convenient service to users in many other countries.

terms.note: 也可说 shared bikes
scan 后接二维码图案
固定表达，指末端接驳
emissions 常用复数
环保出行的简明说法

tips: 「自……以来」常用 Since... 引导，主句用现在完成时，如 Since it emerged in 2015, bike sharing has grown rapidly.
「不仅……还……」用 not only... but also... 连接两个并列谓语，注意 not only 放在助动词之后。

passages.title: 快递业
passages.zh: 中国快递业是近年来发展最快的行业之一。2023年全国快递业务量超一千三百亿件，连续多年世界第一。快递网络覆盖城乡各地，偏远山区也能送货上门。智能分拣中心和无人配送车的应用大大提高了配送效率。如今从网购包裹到生鲜食品都能快速送达。快递业还创造了大量就业岗位，为经济增长注入了新动力。
passages.en: China's express delivery industry is one of the fastest-growing sectors in the country. In 2023, the national parcel volume exceeded 130 billion, ranking first in the world for many consecutive years. The delivery network now covers both cities and the countryside, and even residents in remote mountain areas can receive door-to-door service. Large smart sorting centers and unmanned delivery vehicles have greatly improved efficiency and shortened delivery times. As a result, everything from online shopping orders to fresh food can arrive within hours or days. Couriers on electric scooters have become a familiar sight on city streets, and delivery stations appear in almost every neighborhood. Many small businesses in rural areas now sell their products to customers thousands of kilometers away, thanks to cheap and fast delivery. The rapid growth of the industry has also created millions of jobs, injecting new momentum into the national economy and changing everyday life.

terms.note: parcel delivery 也可指快递服务
快递业务量即 delivery volume
也可用 for years in a row
door-to-door 为复合形容词
sorting 指分拣作业
create jobs 为常用搭配

tips: 「位居世界第一」可用 ranking first in the world 现在分词短语作伴随状语，简洁自然。
列举多项内容时可用冒号引出，如 everything from... to...，避免逐字对应中文顿号结构。

passages.title: 网络购物
passages.zh: 网络购物深刻改变了中国人的消费方式。随着互联网和移动支付的普及，越来越多人习惯网上购物。2023年，全国网上零售额达15.4万亿元，占社会消费品零售总额四分之一以上。双十一等购物节屡创成交新高，吸引数亿消费者参与。网购商品丰富、价格透明，支持七天无理由退货，保障消费者权益。直播带货等新模式涌现，激发消费活力。
passages.en: Online shopping has profoundly changed the way Chinese people consume. With the spread of the Internet and mobile payment, more and more people are used to buying goods online. In 2023, national online retail sales reached 15.4 trillion yuan, accounting for more than a quarter of total retail sales of consumer goods. Large shopping festivals such as Double Eleven have repeatedly set new records for single-day sales, attracting hundreds of millions of consumers. Compared with traditional shopping, online platforms offer a wider range of products at more transparent prices. Most platforms also allow no-questions-asked returns within seven days, which effectively protects consumers' rights. Meanwhile, new models such as live-streaming e-commerce keep emerging, further stimulating consumption and creating new jobs in the digital economy. Online shopping has also narrowed the consumption gap between large cities and small towns, as quality goods can now reach buyers almost anywhere. Thanks to dense courier networks, next-day delivery has become common even in remote counties.

terms.note: 电商可用 e-commerce
不可与已练主题冲突，此处为术语
销售额常用 sales
也可写 Singles' Day shopping festival
固定表达，指无需说明理由
字面为 live-streaming sales

tips: 「占……的四分之一以上」用 account for more than a quarter of...，account for 是描述占比的高频动词。
长句拆分时先找主干（如 Online shopping offers...），再把次要信息用 not only... but also... 或定语从句挂上。

passages.title: 港珠澳大桥
passages.zh: 港珠澳大桥连接香港、珠海和澳门，全长55公里，是世界上最长的跨海大桥之一。大桥于2018年通车，将三地车程从三小时缩短到约45分钟。工程师们克服深海施工、台风频发等困难，创造了多项世界纪录。大桥便利了三地居民往来，促进了粤港澳大湾区经济融合与协同发展，被誉为现代工程奇迹。
passages.en: The Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge links Hong Kong, Zhuhai and Macau across the sea. With a total length of 55 kilometers, it is one of the longest sea-crossing bridges in the world. The bridge officially opened to traffic in 2018 and cut the journey time among the three cities from three hours to about 45 minutes. Building the bridge was extremely challenging: engineers had to work in deep water and deal with frequent typhoons, yet they overcame these difficulties and set several world records. Every day, thousands of vehicles and tourists cross the bridge, making the region feel much closer. It is also a symbol of China's engineering capability and a popular tourist attraction. The bridge greatly facilitates travel and trade among the three cities. More importantly, it promotes economic integration and coordinated development in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and it is widely praised as a miracle in modern engineering.

terms.note: 官方英文名，注意连字符
也可说 sea bridge
open to traffic 为固定搭配
此处简化为 travel time

terms.en: the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
terms.note: 官方译名，须整体记忆
协调发展常用 coordinated

tips: 「将……从三小时缩短到45分钟」用 cut... from... to... 一个动词即可表达缩短，不必逐字译出「缩短」的名词形式。
专有名词较长的机构或工程名（如粤港澳大湾区）采用官方译名并整体记忆，避免现场拼造。

passages.title: 5G技术
passages.zh: 5G即第五代移动通信技术，是继4G之后的新一代网络标准。中国自2019年商用5G以来，基站建设全球领先，截至2023年底已建成三百三十万个5G基站，覆盖所有地级市。5G网络高速率、低时延、大连接，支撑工业互联网、远程医疗和自动驾驶等应用。目前，中国5G用户突破8亿，产业规模持续扩大，正推动各行各业加快数字化转型。
passages.en: 5G, short for fifth-generation mobile network technology, is the new network standard that follows 4G. Since China began commercial 5G services in 2019, it has led the world in building base stations. By the end of 2023, more than 3.3 million 5G base stations had been built, covering all prefecture-level cities. Compared with 4G, 5G networks offer much higher speed, lower delay and the ability to connect far more devices at the same time. These features provide technical support for a wide range of applications, such as the industrial Internet, telemedicine and autonomous driving. At present, the number of 5G users in China has surpassed 800 million, and the market keeps growing steadily across the whole country. The rapidly expanding 5G industry is now driving the digital transformation of almost every sector, from factories and hospitals to farms and schools, and it has become a new engine of economic growth.

terms.note: 简称 5G 即可，首次出现宜解释
移动通信基础设施的固定译法
网络术语，latency 指时延
官方译名，Internet 大写
也可用 remote healthcare
固定搭配

tips: 「截至2023年底」用 By the end of 2023 时主句常用过去完成时，表示站在过去看已经完成的动作。
三个并列特点（高速率、低时延、大连接）可用 with 引导的介词短语前置作状语，使句子主干更突出。

passages.title: 新能源汽车
passages.zh: 新能源汽车是指以电力、氢燃料等新型能源驱动的汽车，代表着汽车产业变革的方向。近年来中国新能源汽车产销增长迅速，2023年产量达九百五十八万辆，销量近九百五十万辆，连续九年全球第一。完整产业链和电池技术创新使中国车企具备较强竞争力，当年出口超一百二十万辆，受到海外消费者欢迎。随着充电设施完善，新能源汽车正走进千家万户。
passages.en: New energy vehicles, often shortened to NEVs, are cars powered by new forms of energy such as electricity and hydrogen. They are widely seen as the direction of change in the global automobile industry. In recent years, China's NEV production and sales have grown rapidly. In 2023, production reached 9.58 million units and sales reached 9.49 million units, ranking first in the world for the ninth consecutive year. Thanks to a complete industrial chain and continuous innovation in battery technology, Chinese car makers have gained strong international competitiveness. In the same year, China exported more than 1.2 million new energy vehicles, which are increasingly welcomed by overseas consumers. Battery costs have also fallen sharply in recent years, making electric cars more affordable for ordinary families. As charging facilities continue to improve, these vehicles are entering households across the country and are expected to gradually replace traditional fuel-powered cars in the coming years.

terms.note: 官方缩写 NEVs 通用
分别译出 production / sales
固定译法
文中以 battery technology 表述
facility 常用复数
意译，不逐字译 thousand households

tips: 「是指……」的定义句式可用 are cars powered by... 过去分词作后置定语，比 which are powered by 更简洁。
「连续九年位居全球第一」用 ranking first in the world for the ninth consecutive year 分词短语，避免另起一句重复主语。

passages.title: 中国航天
passages.zh: 中国航天几十年发展取得举世瞩目的成就。长征系列运载火箭完成超500次发射，将卫星、飞船和空间站舱段送入太空。2021年天问一号成功着陆火星，中国成为第二个实现火星软着陆的国家。2022年中国空间站全面建成，航天员长期在轨开展科学实验。北斗导航系统已服务全球200多个国家和地区，中国正从航天大国迈向航天强国。
passages.en: After decades of development, China's space program has achieved remarkable success that has attracted worldwide attention. The Long March series of carrier rockets has completed more than 500 launches, successfully sending satellites, spacecraft and space station modules into orbit. In 2021, the Tianwen-1 probe landed on Mars, making China the second country in the world to achieve a soft landing on the red planet. In 2022, the Chinese space station was fully assembled, and astronauts now stay in orbit for long periods to carry out scientific experiments and maintain the station. In addition, the BeiDou Navigation Satellite System has been completed and now serves more than 200 countries and regions. These achievements show China's growing capability in space science and technology, and they have inspired strong public interest in space exploration among young people. The country is steadily advancing from a major space power toward a strong space power in the future.

terms.note: 固定译法，也可说 space industry
长征系列 the Long March series
探测器 probe，官方拼写连字符
航天术语
也称 Tiangong space station
官方译名，缩写 BDS

tips: 「使中国成为世界上第二个……的国家」用 making China the second country... 现在分词结果状语，比 which made 更紧凑。
时间推进（2021年、2022年）可各起一句以 In 2021 / In 2022 开头，保持与中文相同的清晰时序。

passages.title: 乡村振兴
passages.zh: 乡村振兴是中国推动农村全面发展的重要战略。自2017年实施以来，各地加大农村基础设施和公共服务投入，农村公路总里程超四百五十万公里，行政村基本实现光纤和4G网络覆盖。特色农业、乡村旅游和电商进村蓬勃发展，农民收入稳步提高。2023年，农村居民人均可支配收入超过两万一千元，城乡收入差距进一步缩小。
passages.en: Rural revitalization is an important national strategy for promoting the all-round development of rural areas in China. Since it was launched in 2017, local governments have increased investment in rural infrastructure and public services. The total length of rural roads has exceeded 4.5 million kilometers, and optical fiber and 4G networks now basically cover all administrative villages. At the same time, new businesses such as specialty agriculture, rural tourism and e-commerce entering villages are booming, and farmers' incomes keep rising. In 2023, the per capita disposable income of rural residents surpassed 21,000 yuan, and the income gap between urban and rural areas narrowed further. These changes have also encouraged more young people to return to their hometowns and start businesses. With better roads, faster networks and higher incomes, the countryside is taking on a completely new look and laying a solid foundation for the modernization of agriculture and rural areas.

terms.note: 官方固定译法
不可数名词
中国基层治理单位
固定搭配
统计学术语，固定译法

terms.en: the income gap between urban and rural areas
terms.note: between... and... 结构

tips: 「自2017年提出以来」用 Since it was proposed in 2017 引导，主句用现在完成时呼应持续至今的动作。
「焕然一新」采用意译 give... a completely new look，避免逐字硬译；四字格翻译以通顺达意优先。

passages.title: 桂林山水
passages.zh: 桂林位于中国广西壮族自治区东北部，是一座以山水风光闻名的旅游城市。漓江从市区蜿蜒流过，两岸奇峰林立，碧水如镜，构成了一幅天然的山水画卷。“桂林山水甲天下”这句谚语数百年来广为流传，吸引了无数中外游客。除了自然景观，桂林还有丰富的特产，如桂林米粉、辣椒酱和三花酒，深受游客喜爱。近年来，桂林注重保护生态环境，努力实现旅游业与环境保护的协调发展。
passages.en: Guilin, located in the northeast of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, is a tourist city famous for its landscape. The Li River winds through the city, with strange peaks standing on both banks and the clear water looking like a mirror, forming a natural painting. The saying "Guilin's scenery is the finest under heaven" has been passed down for centuries and attracts countless visitors from home and abroad. Besides its natural scenery, Guilin is also known for local specialties, such as Guilin rice noodles, chili sauce and Sanhua rice wine, which are loved by tourists. In recent years, Guilin has paid attention to protecting the environment and strives to develop tourism in harmony with environmental protection.

terms.note: 自治区 autonomous region
不会写林立就写 many peaks

terms.en: Guilin's scenery is the finest under heaven
terms.note: 常见固定译法
也可用 local products

tips: “蜿蜒流过”用 winds through 一个词组解决，不会就降级为 flows through
开头长句“位于……，是……城市”用插入语 located in... 处理，避免头重脚轻

passages.title: 景德镇瓷器
passages.zh: 景德镇位于江西省，因瓷器而闻名于世，被称为“瓷都”。这里制瓷历史悠久，早在汉代就开始生产陶器，宋代以后瓷器工艺日趋成熟。景德镇瓷器以“白如玉、明如镜、薄如纸、声如磬”著称，品种繁多，远销世界各地。青花瓷是最具代表性的品种之一，蓝白相间的图案典雅大方，深受人们喜爱。如今，景德镇在传统工艺的基础上不断创新，古老的制瓷技艺焕发出新的生机。
passages.en: Jingdezhen, located in Jiangxi Province, is world-famous for porcelain and is known as the "Porcelain Capital". It has a long history of porcelain making: pottery production began as early as the Han Dynasty, and the craft matured after the Song Dynasty. Jingdezhen porcelain is famous for its jade-like whiteness, mirror-like brightness, paper-like thinness and chime-like sound. It comes in a great variety and is sold all over the world. Blue and white porcelain is one of the most representative types, and its elegant blue-and-white patterns are widely loved. Today, Jingdezhen keeps innovating on the basis of traditional techniques, bringing new vitality to the ancient craft.

terms.note: capital 大写首字母，与 capital 首都同源

terms.en: as early as the Han Dynasty
terms.note: as early as 强调“早”
固定译法
常用搭配

tips: “白如玉、明如镜、薄如纸、声如磬”四个比喻拆成 jade-like / mirror-like / paper-like / chime-like 并列，一句收拢
朝代统一用 the Han/Song Dynasty 模式；“远销”不会就用 is sold all over the world 降级表达

passages.title: 北京烤鸭
passages.zh: 北京烤鸭是中国最著名的美食之一，已有六百多年历史，起源于明朝宫廷，如今是北京的城市名片。正宗烤鸭选用优质填鸭，经烫皮、挂糖色等工序，用果木炭火烤制而成，色泽红润，皮脆肉嫩，肥而不腻。食用时厨师在客人面前将鸭肉片成薄片，配以薄饼、甜面酱和葱丝卷食，风味独特。北京烤鸭深受国人喜爱，也吸引众多外国游客前来品尝。
passages.en: Peking duck is one of the most famous dishes in China, with a history of more than six hundred years. It originated in the imperial court of the Ming Dynasty and has now become a symbol of Beijing. Authentic Peking duck uses high-quality Beijing ducks. The duck is scalded, coated with syrup, and then roasted over fruitwood charcoal. The finished duck has an attractive reddish color, with crisp skin and tender meat, and it tastes rich but not greasy. When serving, the chef slices the duck into thin pieces in front of the guests. Diners wrap the meat in thin pancakes with sweet bean sauce and scallions, and this way of eating gives the dish its unique flavor. Today, restaurants serving roast duck can be found all over Beijing. Peking duck is loved by Chinese people, and it also attracts many foreign tourists who come to the city just to taste this famous dish.

terms.note: 约定俗成的通用译法，首字母常大写
烤鸭经典配料的通用译法
fruitwood 指果树木材，合译为'果木炭'
四字格拆为两个并列短语
转折关系用 but 连接

tips: 历史数字的表达：'已有六百多年的历史'可译为 with a history of more than six hundred years，作状语放在句末更自然。
中文多无主语句（如'再经……烤制而成'），英译时改用被动语态 it is roasted，保证句子主谓完整。

passages.title: 四川火锅
passages.zh: 四川火锅发源于长江码头，已有上百年历史，如今风靡全国。它以麻辣鲜香著称，红亮汤底由牛油、辣椒和花椒熬制而成。吃火锅时，人们把毛肚、肥牛、鸭肠和蔬菜放入沸腾的锅中涮煮，再蘸香油蒜泥调料，味道醇厚。四川火锅讲究围炉而坐、共享一锅，体现了热闹团圆的中国饮食文化。如今它已走出国门，在纽约、伦敦等城市都能品尝到地道的川味火锅。
passages.en: Sichuan hotpot was born at the docks along the Yangtze River more than a hundred years ago. Today it is popular all over the country and beyond. It is famous for its numbing and spicy flavor. The bright red soup is made with beef tallow, dried chilies, and Sichuan peppercorns, and it smells wonderful. When eating hotpot, people put beef tripe, sliced beef, duck intestines, and all kinds of vegetables into the boiling pot. After a quick boil, they dip the food into a sauce made of sesame oil and garlic. The flavor is rich and satisfying. Sichuan hotpot is all about sitting around one bubbling pot and sharing food together, which shows the warm and lively food culture of China. Nowadays, Sichuan hotpot has gone abroad. People can enjoy authentic Sichuan flavor in cities like New York, London, and Tokyo, and the taste of China is winning hearts around the world.

terms.note: 通用译法，也可写作 Sichuan hot pot
产生'麻'味的特色香料，不可译成 chili
牛的胃部，火锅经典食材
tallow 指动物硬脂，比 oil 更准确
四字格提炼核心语义，不必逐字对译

tips: '以……著称'译为 be famous for…，比逐字翻译'著称'更简洁地道。
并列食材的翻译先找通用英文名（如毛肚→beef tripe），译不出来的食材可用拼音加解释。

passages.title: 苏绣
passages.zh: 苏绣是中国四大名绣之一，发源于江苏苏州，已有两千多年历史。苏绣以精细雅洁著称，绣娘用极细丝线在绸缎上绣出山水、花鸟和人物。双面绣是苏绣绝技，同一块绣品正反两面图案相同、针脚整齐。其作品色彩柔和，层次丰富，具有独特的江南韵味。如今苏绣不仅用于服饰和家居装饰，也是艺术珍品。2006年苏绣被列入国家级非物质文化遗产名录。
passages.en: Suzhou embroidery is one of the four most famous styles of embroidery in China. It began in Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, and has a history of more than two thousand years. Suzhou embroidery is known for its fine and elegant work. Craftswomen use extremely thin silk threads to stitch landscapes, flowers, birds, and figures on satin, and the designs look lively and real. Double-sided embroidery is the most amazing skill of Suzhou embroidery. The two sides of the same piece share the same pattern with neat stitches. Suzhou embroidery works have soft colors and rich layers, showing the unique charm of the Jiangnan region. Today, Suzhou embroidery is used not only for clothing and home decoration, but also treasured as precious artworks. In 2006, it was listed in the first group of national intangible cultural heritage, and this ancient craft is gaining new life in the hands of a new generation of embroiderers.

terms.note: 地名加技艺的通用译法

terms.en: the four most famous styles of embroidery
terms.note: 意译'最有名的四大绣种'
直译即可，国际通用
固定官方译法，注意 heritage 用单数
专有地域名可直接用拼音

tips: 长句拆分：中文'以……著称'引导的句子较长时，先译主干 Suzhou embroidery is known for…，再补细节。
'被列入……名录'是典型的无主语句，用被动语态 it was listed as…处理最稳妥。

passages.title: 普洱茶
passages.zh: 普洱茶因产于云南普洱而得名，是中国特有的后发酵茶，历史悠久。它分生茶和熟茶两种：生茶口感浓烈、回甘持久；熟茶醇厚顺滑，带有独特陈香。普洱茶最特别之处在于越陈越香，存放多年后价值更高，被称为'可以喝的古董'。云南古茶山上的千年古茶树至今仍被茶农采摘。近年来随着茶文化复兴，普洱茶越来越受国内外饮茶者的喜爱。
passages.en: Pu'er tea is named after Pu'er in Yunnan Province, where it is produced. It is a special kind of post-fermented tea in China, with a long history. Pu'er tea comes in two types: raw tea and ripe tea. Raw tea tastes strong and leaves a long, sweet aftertaste. Ripe tea is smooth and full, with a special aged aroma. The most special thing about Pu'er tea is that it gets better with age. After many years of storage, it often becomes more valuable, so people call it a drinkable antique. Old tea trees on the ancient tea mountains of Yunnan are still picked by local farmers today. Pu'er tea not only has a unique flavor, but is also believed to help digestion and reduce fat, so tea lovers enjoy it very much. In recent years, as tea culture has become popular again, Pu'er tea has won the hearts of more and more consumers at home and abroad.

terms.note: 地名音译加 tea，撇号不可省略
post- 前缀表示'后'，茶叶分类术语
普洱行业标准译法
'饮后口中回甜'的品茶术语
比喻性说法直译即可，形象易懂

tips: 对比结构用分号或拆句：原文'生茶……；熟茶……'译为两个独立短句，主谓齐全更清晰。
'越陈越香'是比较结构，用 gets better with age 表达，不必逐字对译。

passages.title: 茅台酒
passages.zh: 茅台酒产于贵州茅台镇，是大曲酱香型白酒的鼻祖，已有八百多年酿造历史。茅台镇地处赤水河谷，独特的气候、水质和微生物环境为酿酒提供了绝佳条件。茅台酒以优质高粱和小麦为原料，采用'12987'传统工艺，再经多年窖藏勾调而成。其酱香突出，幽雅细腻，空杯留香持久。茅台酒曾获巴拿马万国博览会金奖，被誉为'国酒'，是高端宴请的首选。
passages.en: Moutai is produced in the town of Moutai, Renhuai City, Guizhou Province. It is the originator of sauce-flavor baijiu made with large qu, with a brewing history of more than eight hundred years. The town lies in the valley of the Chishui River. Its special climate, water quality, and rich microorganisms provide perfect natural conditions for brewing. Moutai uses high-quality sorghum and wheat as raw materials. It follows a traditional process summarized as 12987, which involves repeated rounds of steaming, fermentation, and distillation. The liquor is then aged in cellars for many years and carefully blended before bottling. Moutai is famous for its outstanding sauce aroma, elegant and delicate taste, and a long-lasting fragrance that stays in an empty cup. It won a gold medal at the Panama World Expo. Today, Moutai has become a representative of Chinese baijiu and the first choice for high-end banquets, and it is honored as the national liquor.

terms.note: 国际通用音译，不必加 liquor
白酒官方译法 baijiu 已入牛津词典
酿酒主要原料，注意与 wheat 区分
'窖'译为 cellar，用被动表达
历史事件通用译名
约定俗成的美誉，直译并加引号理解

tips: 工艺流程数字化信息（12987）保留数字，再用同位语展开解释，避免冗长定语从句。
'酱香突出，幽雅细腻'等四字评语按语义重组为形容词短语，用 for 引出，符合英文表达习惯。

passages.title: 宣纸
passages.zh: 宣纸因产于安徽泾县、古属宣州而得名，是中国传统书画用纸，已有一千五百多年历史。宣纸以青檀树皮和沙田稻草为原料，经一百多道工序手工制成。宣纸素有'纸寿千年'之美誉，吸墨润墨性能极佳，充分体现中国书画的笔墨韵味。2009年宣纸制作技艺被联合国教科文组织列入人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录，如今也是收藏馈赠的佳品。
passages.en: Xuan paper is named after Jing County in Anhui Province, which belonged to ancient Xuanzhou, where the paper is made. It is the traditional paper for Chinese calligraphy and painting, with a history of more than 1,500 years. Xuan paper is made by hand from the bark of the blue sandalwood tree and straw from sandy fields. The making involves more than one hundred steps, including soaking, steaming, bleaching, pulping, sheet forming, and drying. Xuan paper enjoys the reputation of paper that lasts a thousand years. It absorbs ink extremely well, so the shades of ink appear in clear layers and fully show the charm of brush and ink in Chinese calligraphy and painting. In 2009, the traditional craft of making Xuan paper was added to the intangible cultural heritage list of UNESCO. Today, Xuan paper is used by calligraphers and painters, and it is also treasured as a fine gift, showing the unique charm of Chinese papermaking to the world.

terms.note: 音译加 paper，国际书画界通用

terms.en: bark of the blue sandalwood tree
terms.note: 原料学名译法，也可用 qingtan bark

terms.en: paper that lasts a thousand years
terms.note: 美誉直译，传达耐保存特性

terms.zh: 非物质文化遗产代表作名录
terms.note: 官方译名的简化通用形式

terms.en: the charm of brush and ink
terms.note: 书画术语固定搭配

tips: 地名溯源句式：'因产于……而得名'用 be named after…，再用 where 定语从句交代产地，一句到底。
工序列举不必逐字对译，选用浸泡 soaking、蒸煮 steaming 等动名词，用 including 引导更紧凑。

passages.title: 龙泉青瓷
passages.zh: 龙泉青瓷产于浙江龙泉，始于三国两晋，盛于宋元，是中国历史最悠久的窑系之一。龙泉青瓷以当地紫金土为原料，釉面青翠温润，被赞为'青如玉、明如镜、声如磬'。宋代烧制出粉青、梅子青等经典釉色。曾沿海上丝绸之路远销海外，成为中外文化交流的使者。2009年其烧制技艺入选人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录，如今在传承古法中不断创新。
passages.en: Longquan celadon is produced in Longquan, Zhejiang Province. Its production began during the Three Kingdoms and Jin periods and reached its peak in the Song and Yuan dynasties. It is one of the kiln traditions with the longest firing history and the widest influence in Chinese porcelain. Longquan celadon is made from local purple-gold clay. Its glaze is green, clear, and warm, and it is praised as jade in color, mirror in shine, and chime in sound. During the Song Dynasty, the Longquan kilns created classic glazes such as powder blue and plum green, reaching the highest level of celadon making. Longquan celadon was shipped overseas along the Maritime Silk Road to Asia, Africa, and Europe, becoming an important messenger of cultural exchange between China and other countries. In 2009, the firing craft of Longquan celadon was added to the intangible cultural heritage list of humanity. Today, on the basis of inheriting ancient methods, Longquan celadon keeps innovating.

terms.note: celadon 指青瓷，国际陶瓷界通用术语
glaze 指瓷器表面的釉
经典釉色名，直译加 glaze
以梅子颜色比喻釉色，直译保留意象
固定官方译名，注意首字母大写

terms.en: jade in color, mirror in shine, and chime in sound
terms.note: 排比结构保留三项对仗，结构对称

tips: 朝代表达用固定译名：三国 Three Kingdoms、宋代 Song Dynasty，注意加 the 和 Dynasty。
比喻'如雨过天青'先译比喻本体 glaze…like the sky after rain，再处理赞誉，避免中文语序直搬。

passages.title: 唐三彩
passages.zh: 唐三彩是盛行于唐代的低温釉陶器，已有一千三百多年历史，因常用黄、绿、褐三色釉而得名。它以黏土作胎，经两次入窑烧制而成，造型生动，色彩绚丽，题材有马、骆驼、仕女和胡人俑，生动再现盛唐的贵族生活与中外交流场景，也见证了丝绸之路的繁荣。唐三彩主要用作随葬明器，如今被各大博物馆珍藏，复仿制品也是受欢迎的旅游纪念品。
passages.en: Tang tri-color glazed pottery, often called Tang Sancai, is a kind of low-temperature glazed pottery that was popular in the Tang Dynasty. It has a history of more than 1,300 years and gets its name because yellow, green, and brown glazes are most commonly used. The body is made of clay and fired in the kiln twice. Tang Sancai features vivid shapes and brilliant colors. Common subjects include horses, camels, court ladies, and foreign merchants, which vividly show the life of nobles and the exchanges between China and other countries in the prosperous Tang period. Masterpieces such as the camel carrying musicians are witnesses to the prosperity of the Silk Road. Tang Sancai was mainly used as burial objects, reflecting the funeral beliefs of Tang people. Today, Tang Sancai pieces are collected by major museums as national treasures, and their reproductions have become popular tourist souvenirs, bringing the grand spirit of the Tang Dynasty into the view of modern people.
